websites.description: All-in-one pet care app with symptom checker, adoption browser, dosage calculator, and wellness box builder. Weight-based medication dosing, drug interaction warnings, and decision-tree diagnostics. React 19, TypeScript, Zustand, Tailwind.
websites.challenge: Built a weight-based dosage calculator with min/max limits and a drug interaction checker that detects dangerous combinations. Created a symptom checker using decision-tree logic that maps answers to severity levels and vet recommendations.

websites.description: Premium Shopify theme ($320) published on the official Theme Store. Dark style with high-contrast layouts, vibrant accents, and conversion-focused tools. 100% positive reviews. Built with Liquid, JavaScript, and SCSS.
websites.challenge: Built a performance-optimized dark theme for gaming/tech stores with promo banners, countdown timers, sticky cart, and quick-view popups — all passing Shopify's strict Theme Store review.

websites.description: Premium Shopify theme ($320) on the official Theme Store. Minimal, refined design for visual storytelling with 30+ sections, scroll animations, and bold typography. 96% positive (27 reviews).
websites.challenge: Created an immersive art-store theme with smooth sliders, scroll reveal effects, and clean layouts. Built 30+ customizable sections while keeping the code fast and maintainable.

websites.description: Premium Shopify theme ($320) on the official Theme Store. Clean, modern design focused on full-width product presentation with conversion tools. 93% positive (27 reviews).
websites.challenge: Developed a conversion-driven theme with promo banners, countdowns, sticky cart, badges, and quick-view popups. Handled complex customization options while ensuring responsive design across all devices.

websites.description: Full-stack music library with React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and Supabase. Browse songs, artists, and albums with a global audio player. Deployed on AWS Amplify.
websites.challenge: Built a full-stack music app where a single audio player keeps playing while you browse different pages, and songs, artists, and albums are stored and fetched from a PostgreSQL database.

websites.description: University timetable generator with a backtracking CSP algorithm. Manages lecturers, rooms, and faculties, then auto-generates conflict-free schedules. React 19, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Express, TypeORM, Supabase.
websites.challenge: Wrote an algorithm that automatically builds university timetables, making sure no lecturer, room, or class is double-booked. The tricky part was fitting everything together without conflicts as the number of classes grows.

websites.description: React + TypeScript demo built with React Hook Form, Yup, styled-components, TanStack Query, and Axios. Submit a validated registration form and fetch live API data with caching.
websites.challenge: Built a registration form with full validation (required fields, formats, matching passwords) using React Hook Form, and fetched live data from an API with caching so it doesn't refetch the same data repeatedly.

websites.description: Classic Battleship vs AI with Hunt/Target algorithm. React 19, TypeScript, Zustand, Framer Motion. Drag-and-drop ship placement, sound effects, hit/miss animations, game stats, and dark/light themes. Fully responsive.
websites.challenge: Built an AI opponent using the Hunt/Target approach: it fires randomly until it lands a hit, then focuses its next shots around that spot. Added drag-and-drop ship placement that prevents overlaps, plus sound effects and hit/miss animations.

websites.description: Real-time MERN chat with Socket.io, typing indicators, emoji reactions, unread badges, and online presence. React 19 + Zustand frontend, Express 5 backend with JWT auth and Cloudinary uploads.
websites.challenge: Built real-time chat with Socket.io so messages, typing indicators, and online status update instantly for everyone in the conversation without refreshing the page.

websites.description: MERN real estate app with property search across 10 countries, dark mode, favorites, compare, price history charts, mortgage calculator, and Google Maps integration. JWT + Google auth, Cloudinary uploads, responsive UI.
websites.challenge: Built a property search that filters by several things at once (location, price, type) and shows results on an interactive map, working across listings from 10 countries.

websites.description: MERN e-commerce store with product search, cart, reviews, and server-verified PayPal checkout. React 19 + RTK Query front end, Express 5 API with JWT auth, Zod validation, and Cloudinary uploads. Serverless on Vercel.
websites.challenge: Built a checkout flow where the server verifies the PayPal payment before completing an order, so prices can't be tampered with on the client. Managed products, cart, and user data with RTK Query, updating the cart instantly in the UI.

websites.description: Travel atlas of Armenia: 461 monasteries, fortresses and mountains from Wikidata. Search by region, find what's nearby, and plan a day on the map. MERN, serverless.
websites.challenge: Imported over 400 landmarks from a public data source and cleaned the data into a consistent format, handling missing fields and bad coordinates. Built map-based search that finds sites near a chosen location, plus a simple day-trip planner.

websites.description: Food delivery app with React 19, Context API, Framer Motion, and Firebase Auth. Features 32+ meals, category filters, a slide-out cart, and 3-step checkout — no Redux or custom backend.
websites.challenge: Managed the shopping cart with React's Context API so any component (meal cards, the cart drawer, checkout) can read and update it without passing props down through every level. Built a 3-step checkout that keeps your info between steps and requires sign-in with Firebase.

websites.description: Fashion e-commerce with React 19, Redux Toolkit, and Framer Motion. Size/color variants, faceted filters, wishlist, quick-view modals, checkout flow, auth, order history, and dark mode. 26 products, fully responsive.
websites.challenge: Built filtering that combines several options at once (size, color, category, price), with the filters saved in the URL so a filtered view can be shared or bookmarked. Handled product variants where different size and color choices change what's available.

websites.description: Day planner that turns plain text like "90m next tuesday" into a task, then warns when the day is overbooked against its set capacity. Built with React, Redux Toolkit.
websites.challenge: Turned typed text like '90m next tuesday' into a task with a duration and a date, so users can add tasks quickly. Added day-capacity tracking that adds up each day's task time and warns when a day is overbooked past its limit.

websites.description: Frontend interview quiz with 250+ questions across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and JS Tricky topics. Features timed questions, difficulty levels, high score tracking, and code block rendering. Built with React 19.
websites.challenge: Built a quiz that shuffles the question order, times each question, and scores harder questions higher. Questions with code show it as a properly formatted, highlighted code block.

websites.description: Music search app built with React 19 and Vite. Browse Apple's top 25 chart, search with debounce, paginate results, and preview 30-second clips. Custom hooks, skeleton loaders, and SCSS design tokens.
websites.challenge: Made search wait until you stop typing before calling the API, so it doesn't fire a request on every keystroke or show results from an old search. Added loading placeholders shaped like the real content so the page doesn't jump when data arrives.

websites.description: Cocktail encyclopedia with React 19, Redux Toolkit, and Vite. Browse 160+ recipes, filter by category or A-Z, save favorites, view recently viewed, and discover with Surprise Me. Lazy loading and skeleton states.
websites.challenge: Organized 160+ cocktails in a Redux store so features like favorites, recently viewed, and filters all read from one source without duplicating data. Images only load as you scroll to them, so the page loads faster.

websites.description: Joke app with text-to-speech, voice selector, 6 categories, saved jokes collection, and dark/light mode. PWA-installable, works offline. Built with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks.
websites.challenge: Used the browser's built-in text-to-speech to read jokes aloud, with a picker for different voices. Made it installable and able to work offline, like a small app, using only plain JavaScript.

websites.description: Static travel site showcasing tours, customer stories, and contact info. Built with HTML, CSS, and JS for a responsive design with smooth, engaging animations.
websites.challenge: Built smooth animations with pure CSS (no animation libraries) and a fully responsive layout using CSS Grid and Flexbox that adapts from phone to desktop — all with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
